name: Blackberry
description: Dark, seedy hedgerow berry, sweet at the edge of tart.

tcm.note: Not classically listed; read with the berry family.

histamine.note: Better tolerated than strawberry, which is the berry SIGHI singles out.

effects.note: A smoothie mixing equal parts blackberry, blueberry, strawberry and raspberry improved executive function for several hours after drinking it in a controlled trial, plausibly through the same anthocyanin route credited to blueberry — though blackberry has less evidence on its own than blueberry does. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
